sup:DEMO-F1.text:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. 

As a family-run foundry, we deeply value our long relationship and take great pride in the dedication of our skilled team. In light of current market conditions, WAGES-METAL rose 3.1 % in twelve months and is 28 % of our cost. 

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €52.90 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We look forward to continuing our trustful cooperation and working together with you.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.subject: Our position
move.body: Thank you for your quote. We read your letter carefully — energy and wages weigh on every foundry this year, and we do not dispute that your costs are real. Please review our counter.

move.text:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We appreciate your understanding of the cost pressures we face, which reflects the mutual respect in our long-standing partnership. Our family foundry has always valued working closely with our neighbors in the region, and we are pleased to find a path forward together.

To support your need for stability, we are prepared to extend the contract term to 24 months, though we must retain our 30-day payment terms. Our current Angebot stands at a price of €52.20 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 30 days net: a price of €51.80 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.subject: Our position
move.body: We understand the increase you announced is not a whim; running a furnace in this market is genuinely hard. We ask you to meet us where a long-term partner can still plan.

move.text:
Guten Tag,

It is always a pleasure to correspond with our long-standing partners in the region. We have reviewed your offer and hold our Angebot. We appreciate your understanding of the genuine challenges of running a furnace in this market. We must therefore hold our position at €52.20 for 60-day payment terms, which already reflects a significant concession on our part to support our long-standing partnership.

For absolute clarity, our offer stands at a price of €52.20 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Please note that this proposal remains valid for 30 days. 

Our family foundry prides itself on the craftsmanship and dedication of our people, and we remain committed to delivering the high quality you have trusted for so many years.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.subject: Our position
move.body: We value that you have always delivered, including in difficult quarters. Our final position follows — we hope you can meet it in the same spirit.

move.text:
Guten Tag,

We appreciate your recognition of our reliability and commitment to delivering in difficult quarters. Over the years, our partnership and shared regional roots have always meant a great deal to our foundry and our people. However, we note that your proposed price has decreased in each round, moving further away from a viable agreement. Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal.

We must therefore state that €52.20 for a 24-month contract with 60-day payment terms is our final offer. 

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. Our Angebot presents a price of €52.20 per unit, a Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. This Angebot remains valid for 7 days. We hope to continue our long standing cooperation on these fair conditions.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH
